faq.q: Which exam boards do you cover?
faq.a: Cambridge O Level, IGCSE and International AS & A Level — plus Pearson Edexcel International A Level (IAL), with unit-by-unit paper structures for Mathematics, Further Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Economics, Business, Accounting and English Language.

faq.q: Are these official Cambridge past papers?
faq.a: No — every practice paper and question bank here is original practice material written for this platform and clearly labelled as such. They follow the official syllabus and paper patterns, but they are not Cambridge examination papers.

faq.q: Do I need an account to study?
faq.a: No — core notes, available study books, flashcards and yearly practice open without an account. You can also sign in or join now; progress and saved Knovo chats remain on this device, while signed-in profile details can sync to your account.

faq.q: Do the notes match the newest syllabus?
faq.a: Paper patterns and notes follow the latest published Cambridge syllabuses. Always confirm against the official syllabus PDF for your exact exam year — a reminder is shown on every subject page.

faq.q: Can I use EduVerse on my phone?
faq.a: Yes — the site is fully mobile-friendly, and when your browser offers it, an "Install App" button appears on this page so EduVerse sits on your home screen like an app.
